text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah says "we will always be soldiers to defend Kuwait".
- Interior Ministry to intensify security on banks, currency exchange outlets and gold shops.
- Kuwait reports Iraqi violation of sea border to the Arab League.
- Farmers' union official says Kuwait to export vegetables to Europe soon.
- Kuwait to host a conference on the legal aspects of privatisation.
- Interior security official says Central Prison is always open to rights bodies.
